CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetMetricData

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Returns a structure with the server's performance monitor counters: page hits, requests running, queued and timed out, and request and database timing figures.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetMetricData("PERF_MONITOR")

Parameters

mode
Must be "PERF_MONITOR". Any other value throws an exception.

Returns

A structure with the keys InstanceName, PageHits, ReqQueued, ReqRunning, ReqTimedOut, BytesIn, BytesOut, AvgQueueTime, AvgReqTime, AvgDBTime and DBHits.

Usage

On Windows NT the same figures appear in the Performance Monitor; this function lets a page build its own status display.

Note  KoldFusion keeps the PageHits, ReqQueued, ReqRunning and ReqTimedOut counters. The byte counts, timing averages and DBHits are always reported as 0.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Perf = GetMetricData("PERF_MONITOR")>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR BGCOLOR="#CCCCCC"><TH>Counter</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP COLLECTION="#Perf#" ITEM="key">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#key#</TD><TD ALIGN="right">#Perf[key]#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
